title: What a smaller business actually needs Test
lede: Most clients come to us without a digital department. We scope the job to the customers you have now, then leave your team able to run it.

items.title: Website & web app
items.body: A site people can use on a phone, with a clear route to enquire, book or buy. Useful when the current site is hard to update, or it does not bring in the work.
items.subject: Website or web app

items.title: Phone & tablet app
items.body: An app for the customers or staff who live on a phone. A better fit than a website when the job is repeated every day, such as bookings, updates or a tool for your team.
items.subject: Phone or tablet app

items.title: Content system
items.body: A back end your office can use. We build it, train the people who will publish, and stay on for maintenance so you are not calling a developer for every change.
items.subject: Content system
